task_requirements.objective: framework-conditioned, epitope-directed design of paired VH/VL candidates (scFv output) against human PD-L1 with H5/35TL as comparator only
constraints: framework = study trastuzumab scFv (Germinal pdbs/scfv.pdb), VH-first, linker AGGGGSGGGGSGGGS
epitope = 5 hotspots (A37/A39/A41/A96/A98, study numbering) + 4.5 A neighbor shell (28 residues total)
metrics: H5 reconstruction control: global complex CA RMSD vs 35TL (published AF3 1.25 A)
